text.p: Columbia Banking System Inc Friday filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed public offering of 1,100,000 shares of common stock, plus 165,000 shares to cover over-allotments, if any.

In a statement the company said it plans to use approximately $10.0 million of the net proceeds of the offering to fund additional loan growth at Columbia State Bank. The remainder will be used to repay $3.0 million borrowed under a line of credit and for general corporate purposes.

Columbia Banking System is a Tacoma, Washington-based bank holding company which operates Columbia State Bank, a state-chartered full-service commercial bank with 15 banking offices in Pierce, King and Cowlitz counties.
